_about: Default AI3D profile, tuned for a 6 GB GPU and 16 GB RAM. Copy this file, edit the copy, and pass it with --config. Single values can also be overridden with --set section.key=value. Relative paths resolve against the ai3d repository root; ~ is expanded.

reference._about: Only used with --prompt-file (text-to-image). With --image the file is copied unchanged.

views._about: Generates side/back views of the SAME character from the front image with Qwen-Image-Edit, so Hunyuan3D-2mv sees all sides instead of guessing. Hand-made views passed with --view-left/--view-back/--view-right always win.

shape._about: model: auto picks mv (multi-view) when side/back views exist, otherwise mini. Choices: auto, mini, mini-turbo, mv, mv-turbo. low_vram keeps only the diffusion model on the GPU while sampling (needed on 6 GB). num_chunks only affects mesh extraction after sampling.

paint._about: Paint3D settings. The old 6 GB-safe profile was quality=fast, max_views=2, view_resolution=256, render_size=512, texture_size=1024. Raise one value at a time.

retopo._about: Builds a clean, watertight low-poly mesh and bakes the painted high-poly colour, normal and roughness onto it. method: quadriflow (quads) or decimate (old behaviour).

rig._about: Mixamo-compatible humanoid skeleton with Blender automatic (heat) weights. Bone names use the prefix so Mixamo animations retarget by name in Three.js.
